about: v0.5b verse-chain duel opponents (OWNER: WP-C; notes/v05b-plan.md §4, types.ts ChainContent): a Kathā duel against a foe listed here is a śloka-antyakṣarī (logic-chain.ts). Each entry: foe (EnemyDef id), links (HP = links × the lead's best hit, default 5), source (where the text puts the exchange).

duels.source: Kiṣkindhā 4.2–3: Sugrīva sends Hanumān to learn who the two armed strangers are; in a mendicant's guise he speaks with them, and Rāma praises his flawless words (4.3.28–29: s-nanrgveda, s-vyakaranam). The chain of verse lines is the game's friendly test of words, not an event of the text.
